name: Westfield Plaza Bonita
description: Westfield Plaza Bonita is a premier regional shopping destination in South San Diego County featuring major department stores including Macy's, JCPenney, Nordstrom Rack, and Target. The center offers diverse shopping, dining, and entertainment options including AMC Theatres, Round1 Bowling & Arcade, and popular restaurants like Outback Steakhouse, Shake Shack, and Tajima Ramen. With national retailers like H&M, Bath & Body Works, and Pandora alongside local favorites, Plaza Bonita serves as the primary retail hub for National City and surrounding communities.
demographics: South San Diego County serving National City, Chula Vista, and surrounding communities with diverse, family-oriented population
summary: South San Diego County's premier regional mall featuring major department stores, diverse dining, AMC Theatres, and over 100 retailers serving National City and surrounding communities.
